summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for:
1. Real-time field-level validation with instant feedback in `src/routes/c.$subdomain.tsx` (phone number formatting, date of birth range, and input validation).
2. Updating trial period from 14 days to 30 days across database functions, onboarding flows, billing screens, and legal/help pages.
3. Automated email alert suite for:
   - 30-day trial expiry notices (7 days before, 3 days before, and on expiry day) with upgrade call-to-action.
   - Payment success and failure notifications sent to both church administrator and primehaven26@gmail.com.
   - Every new church registration alert sent to primehaven26@gmail.com.
   - Every branch registration alert sent to the head church administrator.
4. Instant SMS alerts for all support tickets sent to +233550160237 and church phone numbers using the 'Mene Log' sender ID.
